incident-bot: PAGING: SEV2 — org=sapphire (org_8921) experiencing elevated 429s and token rejections in us-west since 02:18 UTC. Alerts: infra/rl/429-rate. Pager: https://pager.example/INC-5076543210
jamie (on-call): i'm on it, pulling graphs. kai, can you jump in?
kai (sre): on it. spikes look bursty, qps ~4x baseline, KPIs show reranker endpoint spiking CPU. traces: https://obs.example/orgs/sapphire/trace/abcd
marta (support): cs team alerted, customer reports slow responses and some requests failing. pinged liam to confirm customer-side symptoms.
liam (cs): confirmed — Sapphire paused some retries, UX degrading for daytime users. they say batch ingestion kicked off unexpectedly.
jamie (on-call): proposal: temp org-level quota bump +60% and disable expensive reranker-v2 for sapphire for 30m. This should buy time and reduce backend CPU. Thoughts?
alex (prodeng): agree with two-prong approach. disabling reranker will reduce token load. I can prepare the toggle; will monitor model infra.
jamie (on-call): executing emergency commands (runbook step 3).
jamie (on-call): ```
# increase org quota by 60% for 30 minutes
/rlctl set-org-quota --org=sapphire --scale=+60% --duration=30m --reason "emergency spike - temp hotpatch"
```
deploy-bot: change applied: org quota increased for sapphire, change_id=chg_8432, expires=30m, audit=https://audit.example/chg_8432
jamie (on-call): disabling reranker for sapphire now.
jamie (on-call): ```
/rlctl toggle-feature --org=sapphire --feature=reranker-v2 --state=disabled --duration=30m --reason "mitigation for burst"
```
deploy-bot: feature toggle applied: reranker-v2 disabled for org=sapphire, toggle_id=tgl_9921, expires=30m
akai (sre): (note: corrected name) kai (sre): metrics update: 429 rate dropped from ~18% -> ~2% within 90s of quota change + toggle. Latency p50 improved ~120ms. continuing to watch.
alex (prodeng): logs show heavy batch job spikes from ip range 34.56.78.0/24 for sapphire. recommend CS follow-up to ask them to gate that ingestion.
marta (support): CS notified Sapphire ops, they acknowledged and paused the job. they report immediate improvement.
jamie (on-call): good. keeping mitigation for full 30m, will extend if activity resumes. creating incident ticket IN-5076543210 and linking runbook: https://runbook.example/rl-hotpatches
jamie (on-call): handoff note — taylor will take next watch at 03:00 UTC. taylor, please monitor the change expirations and rollback if stable.
taylor (next-oncall): ack, i'll take it. will watch dashboards and check for reoccurrence.
jamie (on-call): post-incident action items: 1) add alert for per-org reranker CPU > 60% of cluster baseline, 2) add automatic short-lived burst protection (soft-burst bucket) for orgs, 3) update support playbook to include immediate customer gating steps. assigning owners in ticket.
liam (cs): noted — i'll schedule a follow-up with Sapphire ops to review ingestion patterns and recommend rate-limiting on their side.
jamie (on-call): thanks all — closing on-call thread, will update ticket with timelines and telemetry. :white_check_mark:
